rules: Retry is permitted only when retryable=true, failure_class is retryable, and attempt_number < max_attempts.
At or beyond max_attempts, retry is forbidden.
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT and DESTRUCTIVE_HUMAN_GATE become BLOCK, never automated retry.
VALIDATION_FAILURE becomes FAIL until a new command/change is issued.
Backoff is deterministic and bounded; no random jitter is used.
